title: Two L-band radars: SAOCOM + NISAR over the Salado basin
summary: Argentina's SAOCOM and NASA-ISRO's NISAR watch the same flooded plain.

layers.label: Cross-sensor visual comparison (not a computed change)

explanation.driver: Heavy autumn rain on the very flat Salado basin left water standing on fields for weeks.
explanation.polarizationNote: Both are L-band (~24 cm): HH separates open water (dark) from flooded vegetation (bright double bounce).
explanation.howToRead: The change map compares SAOCOM with SAOCOM only. The swipe compares SAOCOM (before) with NISAR (after) visually.
explanation.caveats: Dates and place are placeholders until Ibrahim confirms coverage (S3).
